toggles:
One mechanism for every state that changes numbers while active.

Declaration: an optional `toggle` on a feature op, an OptionDef and an item: `toggle: { id?: string (default slug of the name), cost?: Cost, group?: string, while?: Gate[], value?: { min, max, label }, form?: FormDef, endsOn?: 'short'|'long'|'never' (default long) }`. When a feature/option/item has `toggle`, its own `effects` (and `weapons`, `extraDamage` and so on) are pushed into fx ONLY while the toggle is on; without `toggle` they stay always-on as today. Any other effects block can ride a toggle declared elsewhere with `while: ['toggle:<id>']`, which is how subclass riders attach to Rage (Bear totem, Mindless Rage, Divine Fury, Storm Aura), to Hybrid Transformation sub-features, and to Starry Form constellations.

State: a new character field `active: Record<string, true | number | { form: string; hp: number }>` in the note frontmatter (not `choices`, which are level-up decisions). The Features tab and an 'Active' strip at the top of the sheet show a switch per declared toggle. Turning one on spends `cost` (resource, Ki amount, item charges, or a spell slot) via the existing action pipeline and refuses when empty; turning off is free. `group` makes toggles mutually exclusive (Formations, Starry Form shapes, Arcane Armor model). `while` on the toggle auto-suppresses its effects (Rage in heavy armor) without clearing it. `value` stores a number for the formula var `toggle_<id>` (Sharpen the Blade +1..+3, Focused Aim). A rest of type endsOn clears it; incapacitating conditions clear toggles flagged concentration.

Mutagens and other picked options: the choose op still means 'known'; an OptionDef with `toggle` shows a switch on its feature row, so known and active are separate.

Forms (Wild Shape, Circle Forms, Elemental Wild Shape): `toggle.form = { type: 'beast', maxCr: Formula, swim?/fly? gates by level }`. Switching on asks for a creature note within the CR; deriveCharacter then takes str/dex/con, AC, speeds, senses, attacks and a separate HP pool (active[id].hp) from deriveCreature, keeps int/wis/cha, proficiencies (higher of own and beast skill/save), class features and toggles; damage hits the form HP first and overflow carries to the druid on drop. Archdruid sets the Wild Shape resource to Unlimited via modify.

Item toggles: Embercladding Flame Aura, Voidblade storm charge and Crimson Rite on a chosen weapon use the same switch; an item toggle can carry an end-of-turn action (selfDamage) shown while on.
overlay:
A bundled `src/content/overlay/mechanics.json` (plain data, validated with the same validators as notes) that supplies mechanics for features whose source has none.

Key scheme: `<kind>:<owner>:<feature>` where kind = class | subclass | race | subrace | feat | background | option | item | condition; owner = slug of the class/subclass/race/option-list id or name ('*' for any owner, e.g. race:*:relentless-endurance, option:*:archery); feature = slug of the feature/option name. Matching is case-insensitive, strips source suffixes ('(XGE)', ' (TCE)'), parenthetical counts ('Extra Attack (2)' also tries an exact entry first), and normalizes apostrophes and hyphens. Owner aliases map library/SRD/homebrew ids (path-of-the-berserker vs berserker, fighting-style vs fighter-fighting-style vs additional-fighting-style). Feat/background/item/condition keys omit the owner (feat::tough).

What an entry holds: any subset of { effects, toggle, action, actions, ops } where ops are progression ops (resource, scale, dc, grant, choose, spells, modify) run at the feature's level with the feature's Src.

Precedence, applied in progress() when a feature/option row is created: (1) field-level fill, never override: overlay effects/toggle/action are used only when the note's op leaves that field empty; (2) overlay ops are skipped when the note already declares the same resource/scale/dc (by slug) or the same grant value; (3) a note that declares a field wins outright, so curated SRD content and homebrew that already carry mechanics are untouched; (4) when both note and overlay have effects the note wins and the overlay entry is reported once in Progress.problems as 'overlay skipped: note has effects' so drift is visible.

Opt-out: frontmatter `mechanics: manual` on a whole note (class, race, feat, item) disables the overlay for everything it contributes; per-op `overlay: false` on a feature op or OptionDef; a plugin setting 'Built-in mechanics' (on by default). Rows filled by the overlay show a small 'built-in' badge with the entry key so players can see where numbers came from.

Ordering: overlay lookups happen once per progress() and are cached by key; entries are versioned with the plugin, so fixing an entry fixes every character on reload without touching vault notes.

engineBugs: derive.ts hpOf (and carry) read only 'half'/'zero': numeric hpMax and carry modifiers pass validation and are silently dropped (Tough, Dwarven Toughness, Aid, Festering Wound, carry bonuses); ac/attack/damage/save/check also ignore 'half'/'zero'.

Initiative = dex + 'initiative' modifiers only; 'check' modifiers are skipped there and on the raw ability-check buttons (components.ts:49), while effects.ts matches() applies check adv/dis to initiative, so number and roll disagree.
dice.ts sets crit only on natural 20; the derived critRange (Champion, Hexblade's Curse, Warrior Sidekick) never flags a 19/18 as a crit.

Every feature/option effects block is pushed unconditionally (progression.ts feature()), so toggled states cannot carry effects; attack/damage/ac modifiers have no scope or armor condition, so fighting styles and rage damage cannot be entered correctly (War Mind Defense already misapplies +1 AC unarmored).

levelup.ts spellOptions filters by e.data.classes.includes(op.from) and applies op.schools to cantrips and free picks: Magical Secrets can never be taken, and Eldritch Knight/Arcane Trickster cantrips and free-school picks at 3/8/14/20 are wrongly restricted.

choose what: option fails in race/subrace/feat/background grants ('no options list'): the grants OpsCtx passes options {} and GrantsData has no options; OptionDef cannot carry ops, so option picks cannot grant spells, resources, senses or proficiencies.

Optional features (optional: true) gate only their own row: sibling resource/scale/choose ops still apply and the replaced feature still shows (Blessed Strikes vs Divine Strike, Favored Foe, Deft Explorer, Primal Awareness).
Artificer: 'half' progression gives 0 slots at level 1 and floors in multiclass; RAW is two 1st-level slots and round up. Class validator accepts no other progression.
Sidekick class notes have no hitDie and the class validator requires one, so all three sidekick classes are rejected; companions cannot take class levels.
rests.ts shortParts never restores c.spellSlots['pact'] (Warlock Pact Magic does not return on a short rest).

rests.ts excludes reset 'dawn' resources from long rests and nothing else resets them (holy-days module not registered), so dawn resources stay spent forever; dice-based regain (1d3 at dawn) refills to max.
derive.ts adds +prof to every equipped weapon regardless of weapon proficiency; weapon/armor proficiency, armor stealthDis and strReq are parsed but never read.
passivePerception ignores adv/dis sources (+/-5) so Exhaustion/Poisoned/Observant never change it; there is no passive Investigation/Insight.

actions.ts damage has no type and ignores resist/immune/vulnerable; dropping to 0 HP sets no Unconscious and prompts no concentration save; incapacitating conditions do not end concentration; condition immunities are display-only.
panels.ts filters condition_kind disease out of the toggle list, so diseases can never be applied; compendium Concentration/Surprised appear as effect-less toggles.
deriveCreature ignores damage modifiers, saveBonus, acAbility, critRange and checkAdd on raw checks for companions and NPCs.
Resources and DCs from all sources share one slug(name) namespace (resDefs/dcDefs/c.uses): two feats naming 'Misty Step' overwrite each other and share pips.
Attunement counter hard-coded to /3 in components.ts.

Content: SRD races.json/subraces.json have no ability field (no racial ASI); SRD Warlock picks 1 invocation total (RAW 2 rising to 8); SRD Fiend grants expanded spells as always-prepared and 'Dark One's Own Luck' is max(1,cha)/long instead of 1/short; library Bard never switches Bardic Inspiration to short rest at 5; Archdruid never makes Wild Shape unlimited; library Warrior Sidekick Indomitable copies Fighter scaling; library Champion lacks critRange; vault Open Hand lacks Wholeness of Body, vault Lore lacks its 3 skills, vault Life lacks Heavy Armor; Circle of the Land vault note grants all eight terrains' spells; Tactician Improved Contingency Plan and Ultimate Knowing not applied; Hemocraft Wis alternate ignored outside the DC; Voidblade starts with 4 charges instead of 0.
Content: library scales are text ('+10 ft.', '+2'), producing '1d8++2' when used as dice placeholders; scales used numerically must be numbers.

Converter (dnd-compendium ft_classes.py:348-352) gives Ancestral Guardian, Giant and Four Elements a spurious third-caster wizard spellcasting op; drops subclass features nested in options/entries wrappers (Hunter, Totem Warrior, Storm Herald, Tipsy Sway, Soul Blades, Telekinetic Adept); reads only additionalSpells.prepared (ranger subclass lists and innate cantrips lost); drops race armor/tool/weapon proficiency blocks, non-walk speeds and size; title-cases tool names ("Navigator'S Tools") so they never dedupe; House Agent grants all ~21 house tools.
Champion Additional Fighting Style choose does not exclude the style already taken.
deferred: Great Weapon Fighting damage reroll and Savage-style die rerolls on damage: needs a damage-dice reroll pass in the roller; low value, keep as note.
Heavy Armor Master damage reduction and other reduction-by-N: needs typed damage-taking first; note until then.
Conditional save advantage (advVs: Fey Ancestry, Brave, Gnome Cunning, Steel Will, Magic Resistance): shown via note; a save-dialog reminder chip can come later without engine changes.
Indomitable Might check floor = Str score, Superior Inspiration / Perfect Self refill on initiative: low priority, notes.

Sidekick classes (optional hitDie, classes on CompanionEntry) and owner-scaled companion stat blocks (Formula ac/hp/toHit for Steel Defender, Drake, Beast Master): companion pipeline change too large for this build; companions keep fixed numbers.
Slot conversion and recovery buttons (Font of Magic, Arcane Recovery, Eldritch Master), ask-amount metamagic like Twinned: needs slot<->resource transfer actions; manual tracking for now.
attuneMax and Soul of Artifice (attuned count var): small but low priority.
Expanded patron/guild/Divine Soul spell lists (grant.listSpells) and Mystic Arcanum level-restricted picks: medium but depends on the spells-op rewrite; next build after 'from: *'.

Ammunition decrement, versatile second damage button, thrown rows, heavy-for-Small disadvantage, armor/weapon proficiency penalties and Str requirement: need the weapon.properties/category item schema and an inventory migration; schedule as the item-rules build right after this one (the weapon:* roll tags are added now so content written today keeps working).
Healing restrictions from diseases (Sewer Plague, Ghoul Gut) and ability-drain diseases (Bluerot): rare, note only.
Planar Wanderer per-rest rotating choice and Fiendish Resilience: modeled as a toggle group the player re-picks; no automated rotation.

Concentration save prompt on damage and 0-HP Unconscious: listed as engine bugs, but typed damage application is its own task; the concentration roll tag ships now so War Caster/Eldritch Mind apply when the player rolls it.
summary:
Synthesized the 8 audits (about 327 applied, about 676 reference, roughly 230 expressible/new-effect rows) into one build. Engine work, in order:
(1) Extend `modifiers`: Formula values, an `on` roll-tag scope with AND (`+`), additive hpMax/carry, 'double', and passive targets. Feed check modifiers into raw checks and initiative.
(2) Add a `while` gate on effects (armor, shield, wield and toggle states).
(3) Add toggles on features, options and items, with state in a new `character.active`, cost on activation, groups, a value var, and a minimal Wild Shape form swap.
(4) Add 15 small Effects keywords: acFormula, armorDexMax, weaponRule (plus a built-in Unarmed Strike row and an Off-hand row), weapons, extraDamage, critDice, spellDamage, halfProf, d20Rule, senses, speeds, attacks, conditionImmune and abilityBonus, plus roll tags for concentration, weapon:* and passive:*.
(5) Non-effect op changes:
- OptionDef.ops, and options lists on race, feat and background grants
- op `when`/`replaces` for optional features
- ActionDef extensions: an actions list, cost lists, amount 'ask' with {spent}, slot cost with {slot}, Formula placeholders in heal/damage/temp, and tempHp
- item actions with charge costs and dice regain
- spells `from: '*'` and object-form grant.spells (atWill/resource, minLevel)
- an artificer 'half-up' progression
- dc `abil: increased|choose`, and a `dc_<id>` formula var
- grant.feats, choose feat and choose saves
(6) Crit range respected in dice.ts.

A bundled mechanics overlay keyed `<kind>:<owner>:<feature>` fills only the fields a note leaves empty. Authors opt out per note (`mechanics: manual`), per op (`overlay: false`) or with a global setting. 86 overlay entries cover the well-known high and medium gaps. 22 deduplicated engine, content and converter bugs are listed. Item-property rules (versatile, thrown, ammo, proficiency), companion scaling, damage-typed HP and the low-value roller tweaks are deferred to the next build. The audit was read-only; no files were changed. Core files read: /docker/homelab-config/.claude/worktrees/dnd-sheet-spec/obsidian-5e-sheet/src/core/types.ts, src/content/types/effects.ts, src/core/effects.ts, src/core/derive.ts, src/core/progression.ts, src/content/types/ops.ts and src/core/dice.ts.
